Browser

A real browser running on your Mac, streamed into this page. Search Google and open websites without leaving the project.

▶ Run

Runs on its own page, outside the project hub.

Connect your Mac

Download the server package and start it on your Mac. It uses Python packages installed with pip and your existing Chrome browser. Then connect its tunnel URL and secret in Cloudflare.

Download Mac server Setup instructions ↗

How it works

Chrome runs on your Mac and sends its screen to the app. Keep your Mac awake and the server running. Websites can still require CAPTCHA or reject automated browser sessions.
